dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rs3k](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rs3k) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 613.568 depth occurred on Dec 02 2025 34km SW of Ono-I-Lau. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -20.8791 longitude -178.9351. It impacted 371 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
